question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Young
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Young"** refers to someone or something in the early stages of life, growth, or development; typically youthful or inexperienced. (युवा, किशोर)

 
 
• **Example:** The young boy was excited to start his first day at school.
 
 
 
• **"Mature"** refers to someone or something that has fully developed physically, emotionally, or mentally; opposite of young. (परिपक्व)
 
 
• **Example:** She is very mature for her age and always makes thoughtful decisions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'Young'** is **'Mature'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Mature**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boyish** (लड़कों जैसा): Having characteristics or qualities traditionally associated with boys.

 
 
• **Example:** His boyish charm makes him very likable.
 
 
 
• **Moist** (नम): Slightly wet or damp.
 
 
• **Example:** The soil was moist after the rain.
 
 
 
• **Stiff** (कठोर): Rigid, firm, or difficult to bend.
 
 
• **Example:** The cardboard was too stiff to fold easily.
